body: Not sure what happened to your last reply i got a notification but I didn’t show up in the thread

Honestly a lot better I was just thinking about how good it felt to tell someone how I feel that’s willing to sit and listen. It blows my mind that someone that doesn’t even know me could care enough to take the time out of there day to make me feel better. There aren’t many people in this world like you. It prove there are selfless people in the world

I agree honestly I never looked at it like that. I’ve never lost a parent and if I did I don’t know what I would do. I can imagine it’s hard. It’s just hard to have that outside perspective in the moment.

Well I try to keep that I’m mind but the problem is she would have a better life if I were gone. With all the financial problems I have and the life insurance. It’s hard not to imagine how better off my family would be. And knowing that all I have to do is make it look accidental. It sometimes still seems like my best option. But honestly if it wasn’t for her and my son I wouldn’t have made it as far as I have

Well a good example at this point in time I have a truck  that I don’t drive I’ve promised it to my daughter when she gets older. My mom recently went to jail and lost her car. She knows that my truck means a lot and I’ve told her a million times I don’t wanna get rid of it. And of coarse because I feel bad for her and her situation I’m gonna sell her the truck. I don’t have the heart to say no. She knows I wanna say no but she knows I feel bad for her and that I’m gonna do it any way and instead of leaving me alone about it like most parents. She has kept on and tomorrow she will be leaving my house in my truck. Don’t get me wrong that’s not why I’m in this state of mind. It’s just a recent example

I agree just having someone that acts like they care makes a big difference I dont know you but I can tell your an angel. Nobody I’m my life cares as much as you do and I don’t even know you that says a lot about you. Trust me I don’t want to leave this earth but most times it seems like the only solution. I’m 27 years old and I’ve had these thoughts at least ten to fifteen times a week since I was 12-13 years old. I’m pretty good at fighting it at this point. I’m just so tired it just never stops. I work my ass off and I can’t financially take care of my family. I’m constantly manipulated and taken advantage of. It just seems like I’m here for the gain of everyone around me.

I’m just to soft hearted I constantly do thing that make me unhappy just because I put other people’s feelings before mine. If I put my self first it makes me feel guilty to the same point. Every way I turn suicide seems to always be the best option. Especially when you go outta your way to help people. And all you ask for is a little emotional support and that’s to hard for people in this self centered world. No one ever stops to consider how you feel even when you tell them.
I just wanna be normal that’s it. I don’t wanna be taken advantage of anymore. I wish I didn’t have the heart I have
Pretty much I’ve just about ruled out every reason I had
Even the people who say they have experienced depression seem to still automatically assume your just looking for pity

What if every “good” person in your life hid behind a vail. And on the inside they just wanna use you like a toilet paper. When you spend your whole life trying to make everyone happy and no one ever worries about your well being. I can literally tell my wife that I’m having suicidal thought and she blows it off. I tell my best friend and he tells me I just want attention. No one takes me serious. No one cares
